Supervise llama-server on this Mac and serve the agent API on 127.0.0.1:--api-port

Usage:
  lobo local run [flags]

Flags:
      --api-port int     agent API port (default 8932)
      --boot-id string   echoed in /api/status
      --ctx int          context size
  -h, --help             help for run
      --idle-min int     minutes without requests before it stops
      --model string     catalog model id (default "q6")
      --port int         llama-server port (default 8931)

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")
